system.summary: Graphic-sign substitution with nulls and code signs: the Condé party cipher (key DECODE R335, TNA SP 106/1 f. 69), the same as R9238. Not deciphered here.
system.notes: On R335 '&' and '14' are nulls and 'ω' = La Royne d'Angleterre; the heading line of each letter shows them.

prior_solution.where: Forbes, A Full View of the Public Transactions in the Reign of Q. Elizabeth ii (1741) 247-249, 300-303, 319-321; CSP Foreign vi (1869) nos. 7, 145 and the 29 Jan entry

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: foix1563 session had tied f.143 lower and f.148 top to Coligny letters of late January (glosses 'delivr', 'surprendre', 'escrire').
Fetched all nine DECODE images; read the margin headings ('L'Amiral de France a la Reine d'Angleterre', dated) and glosses on each letter; R9239 image 4 = R9240 image 1.

Matched the glosses to Forbes ii (local OCR targets/smith1562/forbes2.txt): 2 Jan Meur ('narrestons'), 24 Jan Orleans ('rayſonnable', 'Normandie', 'vingt quatriesme de Janvier'), 29 Jan Orleans ('surprendre le dict Lyon', 'faict eſcrire', 'gendarmerie', 'delivre').
CSP Foreign vi on British History Online: no. 7 (2 Jan), no. 145 (24 Jan) and the 29 Jan entry are each 'in cipher, deciphered'.

One-key split (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): catalogue 92's two records are in different ciphers. R9238 (Coligny to Elizabeth, 12 Jan 1563) is in the graphic-sign cipher of the Condé key R335, the same key as Coligny's other three letters of January 1563 in coligny1563 (R9237, R9239, R9240), so it moved there; foix1563 keeps R9241 (Catherine de' Medici to Paul de Foix), in de Foix's own cipher. R9238 had been identified on 21 Sept 2026 from the margin glosses 'sins', 'desracine' as the Villefranche letter of 12 Jan 1563 (CSP Foreign vi no. 76; Forbes ii 272-274); the R335 check ('&' and '14' nulls, omega = La Royne d'Angleterre on the heading line of f.142) was made then.

outcome.method_basis: The four Coligny letters to Elizabeth (R9237, R9238, R9239, R9240) were identified from the copyist's margin glosses as letters deciphered at the time (CSP Foreign vi nos. 7, 76, 145 and the 29 Jan 1563 entry) and printed in clear by Forbes, Full View ii (1741); the cipher itself was not deciphered here.
outcome.notes: Read at the time and printed 1741; identified from margin glosses; catalogue entries 93 removed and 92 narrowed, no write-up. R9238 joined from foix1563 on 14 Oct 2026.
